allowOutOfRange.description: If true, the number input element will allow values outside the specified range.

allowWheelScrub.description: If true, the number input element will respond to wheel scrub gestures.

autoFocus.description: If true, the input element is focused during the first mount.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

color.description: The color of the component. It supports both default and custom theme colors, which can be added as shown in the palette customization guide.

controlsPosition.description: The position of the control buttons relative to the input element.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the number input element.

error.description: If true, the label is displayed in an error state.

form.description: Identifies the form that owns the input element.

format.description:
Options to format the input value.
See MDN - Intl.

fullWidth.description: If true, the input will take up the full width of its container.

id.description: The id of the input element.

inputRef.description: The ref of the input element.

largeStep.description: The amount to increment or decrement while holding the Shift key.

locale.description:
The locale used for number formatting and parsing.
See MDN - Intl Number Format.

max.description: The maximum value allowed for the number input element.

min.description: The minimum value allowed for the number input element.

onBlur.description: The blur event handler of the input element.

onFocus.description: The focus event handler of the input element.

onValueChange.description: Callback fired when the numeric value changes. Call eventDetails.cancel() to reject the proposed change.

value.name: value
value.description: The new numeric value, or null when the input is empty.

eventDetails.name: eventDetails
eventDetails.description: The interaction details, including the native event and a reason: "input-change", "input-clear", "input-blur", "input-paste", "keyboard", "increment-press", "decrement-press", "wheel", "scrub", or "none".

onValueCommitted.description: Callback fired when a value is committed. Typing commits on blur. Button and scrub interactions commit on pointer release. Keyboard and wheel changes commit immediately.

value.name: value
value.description: The committed numeric value, or null when the input is empty.

eventDetails.name: eventDetails
eventDetails.description: The interaction details, including the native event and a reason: "input-blur", "input-clear", "keyboard", "increment-press", "decrement-press", "wheel", "scrub", or "none".

readOnly.description: If true, the input element is read-only.

required.description: If true, the label is displayed as required and the input element is required.

scrubArea.description: The area of the input element where the scrub control is displayed. Set to false to hide it.

slotProps.description: The props used for each slot inside.

slots.description: The components used for each slot inside.

smallStep.description: The amount to increment or decrement while holding the Alt key (Option on macOS).

snapOnStep.description: If true, the number input element will snap to the nearest step value.

step.description: The amount to increment or decrement with the buttons, arrow keys, or scrub area. Set min explicitly to enable step validation on form submission. Set to "any" to disable step validation; interactive stepping then uses 1, while the Alt and Shift keys still use smallStep and largeStep.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

value.description: The value of the number input element.

slotDescriptions.decrementButton: The component that renders the decrement button.
slotDescriptions.formHelperText: The component that renders the helper text.
slotDescriptions.incrementButton: The component that renders the increment button.
slotDescriptions.input: The component that renders the input.
slotDescriptions.inputLabel: The component that renders the input's label.
slotDescriptions.root: The component that renders the root
slotDescriptions.scrubArea: The component that renders the scrub area.
slotDescriptions.scrubAreaCursor: The component that renders the scrub area cursor.
